He goes to a school where only people with a unique talent (Geniuses) are allowed, Inspiration Academy! A genius clarinet player, a genus mathmatician, a genius hacker and a genius idol, he gets in all kinds of sexy trouble thisthese crazy people. His fantasies never stop! And what about the love that's starting to grow there? A taboo crazy academic life is about to start!

2.t: An Idol, Even If I Strip!
2.o: Taketo is assigned to interview Utae, the most popular girl in school. He's nervous because he's not sure how she will react to him. Eventually they become friends.

4.o: Raika is in need of a good photograph for the school, and decides she wants to take a photo of Taketo being pervy.

6.o: Taketo is suffering from writer's block. Kurumi locks him in an apartment and gives him 48 hours to meet his deadlines. With him is a young woman that's supposed to cheer him on, but all she does is prolong his writer's block.

7.o: Kurumi gives Taketo a suit that makes him invisible, and tells him to spend the day in the girl's dormitory as research for his work. Naturally, things do not go as planned.

8.o: Everybody is having a free day in Inspiration Academy, and everyone is really excited about this. Taketo decides to go to the town with Ritsu, but he ends up going with the defenseless and innocent Fukune.

9.o: Taketo starts becoming suspicious of Kurumi after she mysteriously vanishes. He has Ran hack into the school's database to find out more about her. Things get more puzzling as the story goes on.

10.o: The upperclassmen decide to pit Inspiration Academy's three first-year classes against each other in a talent competition. Taketo must find a way to win for his class.

1.o: In the river region of The Gambia in 1750, Omoro Kinte and his wife, Binta, give birth to a son, Kunta. Kunta is kidnapped in 1767 and sold to British slave traders. After arriving in Maryland, Virginia planter John Waller purchases Kunta.

2.o: Redcoats attempt to persuade slaves to run away and join the English army. Kunta escapes but slave catchers apprehend him and amputate half of his foot to ensure he never runs off again. John Waller sells Kunta to his younger brother, William.

3.o: George becomes an accomplished trainer of gamecocks and earns the nickname of Chicken George. George marries Matilda, a preacher's daughter, and fathers many children. Tom Lea loses a wager with an Englishman and sells George to save his farm.

4.o: Chicken George returns to the Lea farm after 20 years. George's son, Tom, nurses a grudge against his father. George and Cyrus join the Memphis Colored Battery. Tom returns home after the war to embark on a new life with his family.

1.o: Desna and her girls take pride in doing nails at the Nail Artisans of Manatee County, but amidst painting hooves and dreaming of a better life, she finds herself entangled in a money laundering scheme with the Dixie Mafia.

2.o: Following their entanglement with Roller, Desna and Virginia desperately prepare a cover story to tell the girls and the Dixie Mafia. Desna's dream salon is falling out of her grasp.

3.o: As Virginia's lies deepen, Desna plays catch-up covering their tracks. Desna still has a small shot at her dream salon, and with the help of her crew, she is determined to get it.

4.o: Haunted by Roller, Desna is desperate to get out from under Uncle Daddy's thumb. Bryce drifts deep into the Dixie Mafia. Polly reunites with a former gold-digging "friend," while Quiet Ann is in a lady-mess.

5.o: Desna and Jennifer may be Dr. Ken's only hope, as Bryce wrongly accuses him of a heinous crime. Virginia and Desna are forced to go to Polly for help to rid the world of two horrible birds from Desna's past, with one well-aimed stone.

6.o: All of our girls go to their new fancy salon for the first time. They aren't met with the kindness of strangers. Desna and crew decide to compete in Florida's premiere nail design competition for a big cash prize.

7.o: After the big nail competition, Desna may finally get out from Uncle Daddy's grasp. Jennifer struggles knowing Desna's dark secret, while Polly discovers her previously unknown maternal instincts.

8.o: With a shocking revelation affecting the entire crew, Jennifer finds unexpected solace in her square-dancing instructor. Polly uses all of her powers of bad for good, for the first time, while Quiet Ann is torn about a big decision.

9.o: Desna goes searching for the truth with her crew right behind her, save for Jennifer, who is learning how to cope as a Dixie Mafia wife. When Desna's sleuthing hits pay dirt, she goes to the only person who can save her. Time is running out.

10.o: Following a harrowing escape from Roller's grasp, Desna is on the run. Roller is close behind, running from the Russians. In the end, only Desna can save Jennifer, Roller, and her crew with a sacrifice greater than any she's ever had to make.

2.o: As the mission progresses further, Min-young starts to have doubts about whether they're doing the right thing.

3.o: The agency's newest client is a pop star, at Ah-rang's high school, who has feelings for the class president.

4.o: A problem with Ho-yeol's crush, Se-kyung, is that she like Ah-rang.

5.o: Ah-rang must decide whether to take Se-kyung for himself or give her to Ho-yeol. Byung-hoon's first love, Yoon Yi-seol, returns.

6.o: The agency's new client is a chef who has fallen in love with his rival.

8.o: The agency plans to have Dal-in expose Mi-jin's ex-boyfriend's true colors. Byung-hoon is becoming jealous of Min-young and Seung-pyo.

9.o: A young girl, with a fear of men, comes to the agency asking them to build up her self-confidence so that she can talk to her crush. While Byung-hoon is suffering from superstitious paranoia, Min-young decides to take charge of the mission.

10.o: Moo-jin's grandmother, Madam Hwang, asks the agency to help one of her nurses get a date with her crush, a fireman. Seung-pyo confesses his love for Min-young.

11.o: Byung-hoon tries to help Chul-soo overcome his guilt so he can fall in love with Hae-shim. Seung-pyo wants to hire the agency to help Min-young fall in love with him.

12.o: The agency find out that Hae-shim has cancer. Byung-hoon starts to doubt that the ending of the relationship will be happy. Min-young realizes that she has feelings for Byung-hoon.

13.o: Min-young moves into the Cyrano theater to be closer to Byung-hoon. Byung-hoon decides to accept Seung-pyo's offer to help Min-young fall in love with him.

14.o: A mysterious man blackmails the agency into setting him up with Hye-ri. Seung-pyo forces Byung-hoon to vacate the theater.

15.o: Min-young has been kidnapped! The agency tries to find her.

16.o: The group rescues Min-young. Now they are planning to shut down the agency for good.

1.o: Aoi spends most of her time alone, but an old friend from middle school has arrived to make good on an old promise.

2.o: With the help of Hinata's dad, the girls familiarize themselves with the necessary gear to climb.

3.o: Hinata convinces Aoi to try climbing a mountain, but Aoi thinks they should start with a small mountain and work their way up to the big ones.

4.o: Aoi and Hinata have a camping cook-off.

5.o: Aoi meets a girl from her school who is crazy about backpacking.

6.o: It's Aoi's turn to pick the mountain, so she calls on her new friend to help.

7.o: Aoi picked the mountain but now she needs the right equipment.

8.o: Aoi and Hinata embark on their second climb and meet some interesting people along the way.

9.t: A Forest Girl in the Forest!?
9.o: Hinata teaches Aoi, mountain manners and learns about giant flying squirrels.

10.t: The Climb Isn't Over Until You Descend!?
10.o: Aoi, Hinata, and Kokona help each other down the mountain.

11.o: In preparation for their next trip, Aoi invites Kokona over to help her cook snacks.

12.o: Aoi, Hinata, Kaeda, and Kokona meet up for a picnic at Hannou River.

1.t: Let's Camp Overnight in a Tent!
1.o: Aoi and Hinata put up a real tent in Hinata's yard! Afterwards, Kaede and Kokona join them and they cook a meal outside together. They camp in the tent overnight and get excited about climbing mountains soon.

2.o: Hinata, Kaede and Kokona meet to discuss secret plans to surprise Aoi with a special view of Mt. Fuji, and decide on climbing Mt. Mitsutouge together.  They meet up with Aoi and begin the climb, but they are steadfast in keeping the surprise a secret from her until the top!

3.o: The girls continue their climb up Mt. Mitsutouge and discover plenty of interesting things. The climb gets more difficult, but Kaede shares some wisdom with Aoi. After a difficult part, Hinata is finally able to surprise Aoi with a beautiful view of Mt. Fuji!

4.o: The girls reach the summit of Mt. Mitsutouge and Aoi realizes something about herself. After eating lunch together, they begin their descent. It's a difficult descent, but a reward awaits them at the bottom!

5.o: Aoi, Hinata and Kokona eat crepes together and talk about the past. On the way home, Hinata really embarrasses Aoi. Later, Hinata tries to make up with her but only makes things worse. In the end, Hinata has to think of a way to truly apologize to Aoi.

6.t: In Order to Do What You Love
6.o: Aoi meets with Hinata and her father and gets motivated to climb Mt. Fuji. Aoi begins preparations, but her mom is not okay with the idea of climbing the mountain at night. She learns to stand up for herself and pursue something she really wants.

7.o: You thought it was all about mountain climbing, but no! It's actually about swimming! So obviously you need to buy a swimsuit now.

8.o: Aoi makes the plan for climbing Mt. Fuji. She buys snacks and drinks for the climb the next day. Even though she is prepared, she still feels uneasy. Finally, the big day arrives and the girls make their way to Mt. Fuji.

9.t: Nice to Meet You, Mt. Fuji!
9.o: The girls arrive at the fifth station on Mt. Fuji. They have lunch and Aoi and Kokona buy walking sticks to get stamped along the way. The climb starts and they take it easy on the way up to the eighth station.

10.o: The climb up Mt. Fuji starts to become a bit more difficult. Maybe Mt. Fuji isn't easy after all. Aoi starts to push herself to keep going. Will the girls make it to the top to see the sunrise together?

11.o: Having succumbed to altitude sickness, Aoi is forced to stay behind with Kaede. Hinata and Kokona make it and experience the rising sun atop the summit of Mt. Fuji, and walk around the caldera and to the highest point of Japan. Aoi is extremely frustrated and has to descend the mountain with Kaede, where they later meet up with Hinata and Kokona and head home together.

12.o: Aoi is depressed about not making it to the top of Mt. Fuji. Hinata and Kokona are unsure of how to approach her. How can Aoi recover from such a frustrating defeat?

13.t: The Tale of the Mysterious Firefly
13.o: After being invited to go firefly watching, Aoi and Hinata recall that they once went firefly watching when they were younger. When they ended up getting lost, they were led back to their parents by an alleged firefly, though they both have different ideas about what kind of firefly it was.

14.o: With Aoi's mother still cautious about her climbing up mountains again, Hinata and her father suggest that she invite her to climb Mount Kirigamine with them. Whilst climbing the mountain, Aoi is reminded of the mountain she climbed with Hinata when they were younger, though neither can remember which mountain it was. Hinata's father later reveals that mountain was Mount Tanigawa, leaving the girls excited to try and climb it once more.

15.t: Raincoat Memories: Hey, Yuuka. What Are You Doing Now?
15.o: Upon finding an old raincoat in her closet, Kaede recalls her middle school friend, Yuuka, who was often concerned about her climbing mountains. When Yuuka got upset with her after she ended up spraining her leg, Kaede came to realise she had never taken Yuuka's advice to heart and apologised, after which they bought a raincoat together. Feeling nostalgic, Kaede rings up Yuuka and the two go out shopping together.

16.o: Aoi is anxious about climbing Mount Tanigawa as it involves riding a cable car, which isn't good for her fear of heights. Later, Kaede invites the girls to her house, where she explains she too was scared whilst riding a cable car, but found it less scary on her second go. As Aoi is encouraged by Kaede's words and decides to take on Tanigawa, Kaede gives her her old raincoat that she bought with Yuuka.

17.o: Wanting to help Aoi get over her fear of heights, Hinata takes everyone to Shinrin Park. After participating in various activities, Hinata helps Aoi to cross a suspension bridge before managing to get her to try some bouncy mountains.

18.o: Running low on funds for her mountaineering, Aoi applies for a part-time job at a cake shop. There, she meets college sophomore Hikari Onozuka, who shows her the ropes. After a hard day of work, Aoi feels her horizon has expanded a little.

19.o: Having made much progress in her preparations for the Mt. Tanigawa trip, it soon dawns on Aoi that she hasn't touched her summer homework. With Hinata on vacation, Aoi asks Kaede to help her out, only to find she hasn't finished any of her homework either. Kaede instead calls in Yuuka to help tutor them over the next week, allowing them to get it done in time.

20.o: On the day before the Tanigawa climb, Kokona, whose birthday is on the same day, gets some new shoes as an early present from her mother and decides to go on a walk to Akebano Children's Forest Park to try them out. After returning home, Kokona celebrates her birthday with her mother, who ran a little late home from work. Meanwhile, Aoi, who spent the day making a pound cake, wonders about what will happen after her dream is fulfilled.

21.o: The day of the Mount Tanigawa climb finally arrives, with Hinata also pondering what will happen after she and Aoi fulfil their dream. After a series of staircases and some obligatory forms, the girls arrive at Tanigawa, where Aoi must face the cable car first hand. Despite Aoi still being afraid, the other girls help her get through it before Hinata helps her ride a ski lift.

22.o: As the girls officially start climbing up the mountain, they encounter a quiet young photographer named Honoka, who had previously helped them by the cable car. Interested in her, Aoi decides to follow Honoka as she goes about her photography. After encountering some rainfall, the girls arrive at the mountain hut, where Aoi and Hinata look back on memories of their previous time there, worrying what happens after their promise is fulfilled.

23.o: The girls have Honoka join them for dinner, where they celebrate Kokona's birthday together. Later that night, Honoka gives some advice to Aoi concerning her promise, and the two exchange contact info with her. The next morning, as the girls continue their ascent, Aoi and Hinata look back on their recent adventures as they finally watch the sunrise together, realising that their promise will continue forever as they keep making memories together.

24.o: On the day the Aoi invites Honoka to join her and the others for a fireworks festival, she and Hinata get into another argument with each other. As Aoi takes Honoka on a tour of Hanno, she can't stop thinking about Hinata and decides to try to make up with her, while Hinata hear how Aoi feels about her from Hikari and decides she should apologize too. Both have trouble finding an opportunity to apologize to each other during the festival, but soon find they don't really need to, quickly forgetting why they even fought in the first place.

1.o: Wanting to repay Hinata for the souvenir she got her from Mt. Fuji, Aoi invites her for a late night climb up Mt. Tsukuba to treat her to a night view at the top. Arriving at the top, Aoi resolves to once again take on Mt. Fuji.

2.o: Finding that she won't be able to take on Mt. Fuji again until next summer, Aoi goes with Hinata and Kaede to look at some hiking shoes. Initially sceptical of their price and heaviness, Aoi finds some shoes she likes and climbs up Mt. Tenran to break them in.

3.o: Aoi decides to tackle the Hanno Alps, inevitably finding the experience pretty tough by herself. She is soon joined by Kokona, who accompanies her to Nenogongen to look at the shrines.

4.o: Aoi is approached by her classmate Mio and invites her and Hinata to karaoke out alongside her friends Kasumi and Yuri. As Aoi worries about what to sing, Hinata encourages her not to overthink things and become more confident around everyone.

5.o: Aoi, Hinata, Kokona, and Honoka go to Lockheart Castle in Gunma, each bringing their own unique cameras to take pictures of everything.

6.o: Hearing about "mountain coffee" from Hinata's father, Aoi, feeling provoked by Hinata, becomes determined to try it as well, despite finding coffee bitter in general. After getting some advice from Kaede and Yuka, Aoi goes with Hinata to the Kanhasshu Observation Platform, where she puts her coffee making into practise.

7.t: She Who Does Not Work, Neither Shall She Climb?!
7.o: With Aoi busy at her part-time job, Hinata goes on an outing by herself, finding herself lonely without Aoi. During closing time, Aoi manages to use what she learned throughout today to help Kokona's mother buy a cake for her daughter.

8.o: Aoi makes plans to go to Gunma with Honoka while Hinata, unable to get in touch with Aoi, ends up making plans to go to Mt. Akagi with Kokona on the same day.

9.o: Aoi and Honoka explore Gunma's shrines and go to a hot spring while Hinata and Kokona reach the peak of Mt. Akagi. At the end of the day, Aoi, Hinata, and Kokona ride the same train home, where Hinata becomes jealous of all the time Aoi spent with Honoka.

10.o: Aoi’s classmates invite her to hang out at Ikebukuro. She knows Hinata has prior arrangements that day, so she hesitates, but decides to go anyway.

11.o: Aoi buys Hinata a gift, but Hinata’s mind seems to be elsewhere. Meanwhile, Kaede makes plans for the gang to climb Mt. Kinpu on an overnight trip.

12.o: Hinata hurts her foot, and Aoi decides to stay behind with her while Kokona and Kaede finish the trip to the top of Mt. Kinpu.

13.o: It’s November, and Hinata’s birthday is coming up. Aoi tries to choose a gift for her, but nothing seems right.

7.o: In the wake of the explosion, the hospital welcomes a woman who is about to give birth. Her baby, whom she names George, is born into a broken world.

8.o: Mai spends her time at home alone, with only her piano for company. After the explosion, Mai finds solace in music and tries to use her passion for it to move on.

9.o: As Tarek and Maya have a photo session prior to their wedding, the fire causes Maya to have difficulty breathing, before the situation escalates and the fire turns into an explosion.

10.o: A couple's beach vacation takes a morbid turn as the wife shares how she wants her funeral to go when she dies. On their way back home, the explosion turns the day into a tragedy as the husband is killed.

12.o: When Maya gets severely injured, a stranger takes her in his car as he looks for help. He finally manages to get her to a hospital, but disappears before telling her who he is.

13.o: As the explosion destroys their house, a mother tries to survive with her baby when they get trapped inside. The neighbors finally manage to reach them and lend a hand.

14.o: During the explosion, a girl recalls her ordinary life with her brother in their family home. As she wakes up in the aftermath, she discovers that she has lost her brother.

15.o: Sarah has always dreamed of establishing contact with outer space. After the explosion, her father looks for her everywhere after he loses his hand. When he finally finds her in the hospital, he learns that all her dreams have come to an end.

دينجي هو مراهق يعيش حياته كصياد الشيطان.

بهدف سداد الدين الذي ورثه عن والده، يبدأ في صيد الشياطين من أجل الياكوزا مع صديقه بوتشيتا، "شيطان المنشار"، بينما يعيش حياة فقيرة بشكل مأساوي.

فقط عندما تبدو الأمور وكأنها لا يمكن أن تزداد سوءا، يتعرض دينجي للخيانة والقتل من قبل الياكوزا. عندما يبدأ دينجي في الوعي، يسمع شخصا يتصل من داخل رأسه...

2.o:
بعد احتجازه من قبل ماكيما، أحد صائدي شيطان السلامة العامة، يجد دينجي نفسه في حبها بفضل تلميحاتها الإيحائية.

يرغب دينجي في التعاون مع ماكيما، ويصل إلى مقر صائدي الشيطان في طوكيو، ويتعرف على أكي هاياكاوا، وهو صياد كبير كان من المفترض أن يتشارك معه. ولكن بعد ذلك يضرب هاياكاوا دينجي، ويطالبه "بالترك هذه الوظيفة"...

3.o:
يقرر دينجي أن حلمه الجديد هو "مداعبة بعض الثدي".

يعرض شريكه، Power the Blood Fiend، السماح له بالشعور بثدييها فقط إذا أنقذ قطتها الأليفة القديمة Meowy من شيطان.

مع حلمه في الأفق، دينجي متحمس ومستعد للذهاب، حتى...

4.o:
بعد معركة شرسة، يهزم دينجي "شيطان الوطواط" وينقذ القوة حتى بعد أن حاصرته.

يقول إن كل شيء من أجل "لمس ثدي القوة".

تسخر باور من دافعه السخيف قائلة "هذا سبب غبي جدا"، لكنها لا تزال توافق على السماح له بمداعبة ثدييها.

بينما يشعر دينجي بسعادة غامرة بالفكرة، فإنه يواجه هجوما مفاجئا من العدم...

5.o: يبدأ آكي هاياكاوا ودينجي وباور في العيش معًا. يحقق دينجي أخيرًا حلمه بلمس ثديي باور، لكنه يصاب بالصدمة عندما لا تسير الأمور كما كان يتوقع. وبينما يدرك دينجي أن السعي وراء حلمه كان أكثر متعة من تحقيقه، تقترب منه ماكيما وتقول: «إذا تمكنت من قتل شيطان المسدس، سأحقق لك أمنية واحدة».

6.o: يدخل دينجي وأعضاء الوحدة الخاصة الرابعة بطوكيو إلى فندق لاستعادة جزء من «شيطان المسدس». لكنهم ينتهي بهم الأمر محاصرين في الطابق الثامن بسبب القدرة الخارقة لشيطان. وبينما يجد الأعضاء أنفسهم محاصرين في الطابق الثامن الذي لا نهاية له، ويبدو أنه لا مفر لهم، يقدم لهم الشيطان عرضًا: «إذا سمحتم لي بأكل دينجي، سأسمح لجميع صائدي الشياطين الآخرين بالرحيل سالمين».

7.o: يتعرض أكي للطعن على يد كوبيني أثناء دفاعه عن دينجي. ولدى رؤية ذلك، يقفز دينجي داخل «شيطان الأبدية» ويبدأ في مهاجمته. لكنه يفشل في قتل «شيطان الأبدية»، وتبدأ قوة منشاره في التلاشي بعد أن فقد كمية كبيرة من الدم. لكنه يتمكن بعد ذلك من استعادة قوته بعد أن أكل لحم الشيطان وشرب دمه، ويبدأ في الرد بالهجوم. بينما تراقب هيمينو دينجي، تتذكر مقولة ”صيادو الشياطين الذين تهابهم الشياطين هم أولئك الذين يعانون من بعض الاختلالات النفسية.

8.o: يختبر دينجي أول قبلة له، وهي قبلة مفجعة. يتم اصطحاب دينجي وهو في حالة سكر إلى منزل هيمينو، حيث تبدأ في إغوائه. وبينما يشعر بانقسام بين ماكيما التي يحبها، وهيمينو الواقفة أمامه، يقرر دينجي الوقوع في الفتنة. لكنه يجد بعد ذلك شيئًا في جيبه: مصاصة «تشوبا تشوبس» التي أعطته إياها ماكيما.

9.o: تندلع معركة شرسة بين دينجي و”شيطان الكاتانا“ المهدد. لكن حتى بعد أن أخذ دينجي أحد رفاق ”شيطان الكاتانا“ رهينة، قام ”شيطان الكاتانا“ بتقطيعهما حتى أمسك بدينجي. وفي الوقت نفسه، بعد أن بدا أنها قُتلت، اتضح أن ماكيما لا تزال على قيد الحياة. فتشرع في إنقاذ دينجي بمساعدة كوروسي وتيندو، صائدي الشياطين التابعين للسلامة العامة من كيوتو.

10.o: أدى الهجوم الوحشي الذي شنه شيطان الكاتانا إلى خسارة العديد من أفراد القسم الرابع التابع للسلامة العامة. يستيقظ آكي هاياكاوا على سرير المستشفى، غير قادر على تقبل حقيقة فقدان هيمينو. ثم يظهر كوروسي وتيندو أمام هاياكاوا، ليخبراه بأنهما سيتوليان الآن مهمة توجيهه. في هذه الأثناء، تقدم ماكيما دينجي وباور إلى أحد أعضاء السلامة العامة الذي سيكون بمثابة مرشدهم من أجل تعزيز قوة القسم الرابع.

11.o: يكمل دينجي وباور تدريبهما مع كيشيبي، بينما يبرم أكي هاياكاوا عقدًا جديدًا مع ”شيطان المستقبل“ عبر كوروسي وتيندو. في هذه الأثناء، تهدد ماكيما زعيم الياكوزا لإجباره على الكشف عن أسماء جميع الذين أبرموا عقودًا مع ”شيطان المسدس“، بالإضافة إلى مكان مخبأ شيطان الكاتانا. قد حان وقت السلامة العامة أخيرًا في بدء هجومها المضاد ضد شيطان الكاتانا ورفاقه.

12.o: يُرسل سواتاري «شيطان الشبح» لمطاردة هاياكاوا، وكاد يقتله «شيطان الشبح» لولا أنه توقف وأعطاه سيجارة تحمل رسالة من هيمينو. تمنح الكلمات المكتوبة داخلها هاياكاوا القوة لقتل «شيطان الشبح» والقبض على سواتاري. في هذه الأثناء، يتجه دينجي إلى مواجهته الثانية مع شيطان الكاتانا. وبسحب المشغل الموجود على صدره، يتحول إلى الرجل المنشار. والآن، بدأت المعركة الأخيرة بين الرجل المنشار وشيطان الكاتانا...

1.o: حين تعلم زوجة السياسي والجاسوسة المتخفية "هيلين ويب" بمقتل حبيبها، تعيّن منظمة "الحمام الأسود" صديقًا قديمًا للمساعدة في حمايتها.

2.o: بعد الوصول إلى نهاية طريق مسدود في البحث عن قاتل "جيسون"، يجب على "هيلين" القتال لتنجو بحياتها، فيما يتلقّى "سام" تهديدًا من ربّة عمله السابقة.

3.o: تعود ذكريات من ماضي "سام" لتقضّ مضجعه، بينما يستعد لإنهاء مهمة بدأها قبل سبع سنوات. ويلتقي "والاس" سرًّا بمبعوث صيني.

4.o: تصل ملابسات التحقيقات في مقتل السفير إلى أعلى المستويات في السلطة، وتذهب "هيلين" في زيارة محفوفة بالمخاطر إلى صديقة قديمة، ويواجه "سام" خيارًا صعبًا.

5.o: مع اقتراب الخطر ودنوّه، يلجأ "سام" إلى المكان الآمن الوحيد الذي يعرفه ويوجّه "ريد" إنذارًا نهائيًا، فيما تقترب "هيلين" خطوة أكثر من معرفة الحقيقة.

6.o: تنطلق "هيلين" للبحث عن آل "كلارك" عازمة على الانتقام والدليل في يدها. وبينما تتكشف المؤامرة شيئًا فشيئًا، تتخذ قرارًا قد يودي بحياتها.

1.o: Tang Yang was transferred to the bank branch as Deputy Director. On his first day, Jiang Shiyan, a new entrepreneur, drove Tang Yang to work. Unexpectedly, Tang Yang was isolated by his colleagues on her first day...

8.t: The Probability of Friendship Changing into Love
8.o: Tang Yang asked Jiang Yanan out and talked about a story of friendship changing into love..

10.o: Everyone gossiped about the relationship between Tang Yang and Jiang Shiyan. Jiang Shiyan came to see Tang Yang with the scarf that Tang Yang had forgotten at Yi Xiu, but Tang Yang told Jiang Shiyan not to come to see her again.

12.t: Yang Makes Your Dreams Come True
12.o: Tang Yang, Jiang Shiyan, Feng Weiran, and Jiang Yanan followed the tradition and went up the mountain to watch the sunrise. The four of them looked at the sun gradually rising above the horizon and couldn't help but reminisce about the past.

13.t: Reunion Is Only Complete With You
13.o: Jiang Shiyan confirmed with Tang Yang for her relatives' details, and was busy making plans to celebrate the New Year with Tang Yang's family.

14.o: When the family members were having a reunion dinner, they talked about Tang Yang and Jiang Shiyan's childhood. The two couldn't stand it and fled...

15.t: How to Be Willing to Be Just Friends
15.o: Jiang Shiyan used his cousin's experience to ask Jiang Yanan about Tang Yang's attitude towards him. After listening, Jiang Shiyan left in disappointment...

16.o: Tang Yang invited a lawyer to give a lecture on sexual harassment of women in the workplace. Gan Yiming looked embarrassed, and then he led Tang Yang to an open space outside the venue and made a move on her!

17.o: Tang Yang and Jiang Shiyan decided not to push too much on their relationship. But as they tried so hard to stay 'normal', they became more embarrassed.

18.o: Tang Yang and Jiang Shiyan gathered with their high school friends and talked about the past days. Everyone agreed that Chang Xinyi was the perfect match for Jiang Shiyan. Tang Yang was envious, but she pretended not to care about what they said.

19.t: I Envy Him, but I Envy You More
19.o: Chang Xinyi met with Tang Yang, hoping that Tang Yang could help promote cooperation between the two parties, but Tang Yang said that he respected Jiang Shiyan's decision. Chang Xinyi couldn't help but envy the two.

20.o: After Tang Yang returned from the Economic Crime Investigation Unit, there was a lot of gossip within CBBC. Rumors that Tang Yang had accepted bribes spread like wildfire...

21.o: Tang Yang decided to take a leave to accompany Jiang Shiyan beside the bed. The two stuck to each other every minute.

22.o: Seeing that Tang Yang had not returned yet, Jiang Shiyan went out to look for her worriedly, and finally found Tang Yang, who was crying. Jiang Shiyan knew that Tang Yang had been wronged, therefore he hugged her...

23.t: It's Either a Surprise or a Shock
23.o: Director Gan asked Tang Yang if she was deliberately delaying Qinglai Art Training's loan application. Tang Yang bluntly said that Qinglai's application had inestimable risks...

24.o: Jiang Shiyan held Tang Yang's hand tightly. He was afraid that all this was just a dream. Tang Yang's firmness gave Jiang Shiyan an infinite sense of security.

25.o: Tang Yang received Jiang Shiyan's video, and Jiang Shiyan decided to come to celebrate Tang Yang's birthday. Tang Yang was happy, but felt sorry that Jiang Shiyan was tired because of travelling.

26.o: The audit team hired by Dingsheng settled in Yixiu, and the person in charge was Tang Yang's ex-boyfriend Song Jing. Jiang Shiyan thought a lot and finally decided to tell Tang Yang, but Tang Yang didn't really care.

27.t: What Horrible Messages Did You Recall?
27.o: Tang Yang received a large bouquet of flowers. She immediately took a photo and sent a message to her boyfriend to show her appreciation. But when she flipped the card, she saw something unexpected.

28.o: Yi Xiu's financing entered the final stage, and Jiang Shiyan asked Feng Weiran to follow up. Tang Yang found that the abnormal loan applications seemed to be related to Xu Shanshan, but there seemed to be no way to figure out the connection behind it.

2.t: Making of Some Aerial Photography! / Visiting a Classmate, 3000 Leagues - Motovlog Part 12

Haruno tries to carry out her plan to visit these manga pilgrimage sites on an ambitious schedule, but the other members of the Cinephoto Club can't seem to hide their unease. And so begins the hellish schedule of this location scouting tour....

9.t: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Second Night)

10.t: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Third Night)
